turns.question: Is it a physical, tangible object?

evidence.excerpt: Cambridge defines eyebrow as “the line of short hairs above each eye in humans.”
Merriam-Webster's medical definition describes an eyebrow as “the ridge over the eye or the hair growing usually in a line or arch on the skin over it.”
The eyebrow is the arch of hair on the brow.

The area of curved, delicate hairs above our eyes are believed to channel unwanted moisture—sweat and rain in particular—away from the eye. They also help to block out light and filter dust and dirt that may fall into the eyes.
Eyebrow hair serves many important biologic and aesthetic functions. This article reviews the structure and function of the hair follicle, as well as hair follicle morphogenesis and cycling.
